title: Change selected array items
summary: Fortran: Change selected array items. Use a limit of 9.
introduction: where applies a change only where an array condition is true.
learningObjectives: Change selected array items with Fortran

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.

blocks.title: Change selected array items
blocks.code:
program lesson
  implicit none
integer :: scores(3) = [4, 8, 9]
where (scores >= 7) scores = scores + 1
write(*,'(3(I0,1X))') scores
end program lesson

blocks.text: The condition selects the last two positions. Only those values increase, becoming 9 and 10.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The mask and array must have compatible shapes.
